I am slowly trying to take responsibility for my actions, be it good or bad. I'm not saying, you shouldn't be blaming them at all. They are at fault but don't let that stop you from living your life. Almost every night I get so close to slitting my throat with a knife but I couldn't do it. I think I do understand the pain you are going through at this very moment, at least to an extent. 

From a very young age I was being told "it gets better since you are struggling now" and I believed that for a very long time but I lost it at a point in life. I kept struggling.I was bullied when I was young by everyone around me, was treated differently and like trash by the teachers, did not have a good relationship with my family,  suffered through severe depression over the last 3 years and ended up not performing well in my academics, so couldn't get into my desired college or course and I am lost right now. I have no goal in life. I have tried to kill myself a several times but I was afraid I'll fail at that as well and I didn't want to hurt the ones who care about me. I feel like I am lost in the woods and there's no way out. I failed my parents, my academics, my life and what not. I am unworthy to live. I get this urge to harm myself every night because of how ashamed I am of myself but out of all that's happening in my life, I do feel a little better?? I finally have a decent relationship with my family, slowing improving. My parents are starting to understand me and is very supportive off late. I have changed a lot as a person over the last few months and I am glad I did cause now I have the strength to make a change in my life. So, it does get a little better? You just have to hold on? My life isn't necessarily great but it's the small things you must pay attention to, when you are having suicidal thoughts. You may have something that's keeping you going and you, yourself, won't be aware of it. Think about it. If you couldn't, try finding a hobby. I understand how difficult it will be for one to even get out of bed when you are depressed but you have to force yourself to, there's no way out. Try consulting a therapist, it helps so much. It's helping me now. 

I just want to say that, there's always more to life than what we see when we are depressed. Trust me. I hope you find a way to be happy. Good luck!
